{{Top|leg}}
A '''Central Databank''' was used on [[Sarcophagus]], the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sacorria]]. Sarcophagus served as a mass graveyard for the residents of Sacorria, which necessitated the use of the Central Databank to keep track of the locations of every burial plot.<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
